title: a journal line lands in the file at the path, even when git replaced it under the open handle
intention: The artifact door never drops a journal line silently when git rewrites the tree it writes into: a git rewrite run under `cairn artifact quiet` cannot interleave with a door write, and a rewrite that ignores it makes the door raise and park the entry, never drop it.
why: Measured 2026-11-13: f695fac922cd's PROVEME cursor write (cert certificates/f695fac922cd-PROVEME-20261113T163007Z-80cd.cert.json) kept its bytes but lost its journal line inside a batch's pull --rebase --autostash in the live commons, and every commons commit then refused with 'changed around the door'. A scratch repro showed git stash replacing the journal inode under _append's open a+ handle: the line went to the orphaned inode, the record rode the stash back.
traces_to: Law 7: errors are permanent in records of truth, and the journal is the record of who wrote every record. Law 8: a peer leans on the journal's chain without re-checking it.
how: The door holds a repo-level flock (<git dir>/cairn-door.lock) across the record write and the journal append; `cairn artifact quiet -- <git cmd>` holds the same lock around a git rewrite. _append re-opens when its locked handle is not the file at the path (lock time), and after the write, if the path names a different file, parks the entry in <git dir>/cairn-orphaned-lines.jsonl and raises loud. close.sh wraps its pull --rebase --autostash in quiet.

clauses.claim: a git rewrite run under quiet cannot interleave with a door write; a rewrite that ignores it makes the door raise and park the entry, never drop it
an append with no rewrite writes exactly one line, chained on the prior tail

decisions.text: D1: artifact.py gains door_lock(root): an exclusive flock (msvcrt on nt) on <git dir>/cairn-door.lock, git dir from `git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir` at the root (no git dir: no lock), re-entrant within a process. write() and remove() hold it across the record write and _append. _append checks (st_dev, st_ino) of its locked handle against the path: at lock time a mismatch re-opens and re-locks, at most 5 tries, then raises OSError naming the path; after the write and fsync a mismatch appends the entry to <git dir>/cairn-orphaned-lines.jsonl and raises JournalLineOrphaned naming the path, the entry id and the park file. On nt a zero st_ino skips the check. The docstrings name this ticket.
D2: `cairn artifact quiet [-C <dir>] -- <cmd...>` takes door_lock for the git dir at <dir> (default cwd), runs the command, releases, and exits with its code.
D3: close.sh's two `git pull -q --rebase --autostash` run under `bin/cairn artifact quiet --`.

D4: the proof builds a scratch git repo with a journal (prior entries, one uncommitted) and points the door at it with set_diagnostic_roots. Tooth 1: (a) a `quiet -- sh -c 'git stash push; sleep; git stash pop'` subprocess holds the lock while a door write starts; the write lands after the pop, with the record's bytes, its line once, verify_chain [] and the stash list empty; (b) a stash run on the journal's first open, ignoring the lock, makes the door raise JournalLineOrphaned and the entry stands in the park file; (c) a file replaced at the path between open and lock gets the line, once. Red on the old code. Tooth 2: a write with no rewrite adds exactly one line chained on the tail. PROVES names clauses 1 and 2; sealed in the same commit.

the verdict gate's re-run of test_artifact_door redded test_a_scratch_world_never_reaches_the_live_journal on a line count over live data (37470 -> 37471, 0 scratch entries): another fleet writer appended during the run. The tooth now asserts no scratch entry only (cairn e7ddffd20), its why; resealed green twice

measured.saw: git stash replaced the journal's inode under an open a+ handle; the line written through the handle was missing from the journal at the path after the pop, while the state file kept its new bytes
measured.how: scratch repro repro_inode.py (inode replaced: True; st: s1; journal: [base, earlier_uncommitted]), and the live f695fac922cd state.json at 418522b68877 with no journal line, inside the commons reflog's 16:29:58-16:30:28Z pull --rebase --autostash

measured.saw: re-landing the line in the file at the path mid-stash makes `git stash pop` refuse (local changes would be overwritten); the stash keeps the record's new bytes and the earlier lines, with or without the merge driver
measured.how: scratch repro repro_reland.py, both variants; the cast D1 was re-scoped on this measurement with the orchestrator's go
